name: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders with a slow band of light, and a reveal that blurs them into the real content.

props.name: className
props.description: Size and shape, e.g. h-4 w-32 or rounded-lg. Every skeleton on screen sweeps in phase. Accepts every prop of a div.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of lines. The last one is shorter.

props.name: lineClassName
props.description: Classes for each line, e.g. a different height.

props.name: loading
props.description: While true the skeleton shows. When it turns false the skeleton blurs out as the content blurs in, over 320ms, in the same box.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: The placeholder, shaped like the content so nothing moves.

props.name: children
props.description: The content. It stays mounted but inert and hidden while loading.
